title: Zelle Scams Stole $1.9B — Banks Keep It Legally
hook: When a scammer tricks you into sending money on Zelle, your bank isn't required to refund a single dollar — and that loophole cost Americans $1.9 billion last year.
angle: Everyone assumes digital payments are protected like credit cards — they're not, and the legal gap is a $1.9B annual trap that scammers exploit on purpose
audience: Anyone who uses Zelle, Venmo, or CashApp — especially people who haven't thought about the protection gap vs credit cards
key_numbers: $1.9 billion lost to P2P scams annually
0 days to dispute on Zelle vs 60 days for credit cards
Under 3% recovery rate on Zelle fraud
